posts.text: Clayton Tucker, a Lampasas rancher and progressive activist, won the Texas Ag Commissioner race, campaigning against data centers in rural Texas and focusing on food safety and affordability.
posts.source: Democrat Clayton Tucker wins Texas Ag Commissioner race, flipping seat

posts.text: Wyoming's Proposition 1, which aimed to cut property taxes for qualifying homes, was rejected in all but one county. Lincoln County was the only one where it passed.
posts.source: Prop. 1 Only Survived One County, Lincoln, And Niobrara Rejected It The Hardest | Cowboy State Daily

posts.text: Nathan Johnson, newly elected Texas Attorney General, composed the music for 67 episodes and five movies of the anime series 'Dragon Ball Z' before his political career.
posts.source: Nathan Johnson Made Dragon Ball Z Music Before Texas Attorney General Win

posts.text: Former Yankees player Mark Teixeira won the U.S. House race in Texas' 21st congressional district, defeating Democrat Kristin Hook with 54.5% of the vote.
posts.source: Former Yankees star Mark Teixeira wins U.S. House seat in Texas - Newsday

posts.text: Outgoing Republican U.S. Sen. John Cornyn congratulated Democrat James Talarico on his historic victory in Texas’ Senate race.
posts.source: 'The voters have spoken': John Cornyn congratulates James Talarico after Ken Paxton's defeat
